items.title_zh: MindAid 辅助型 SSVEP 脑机接口
bullets_zh: MindAid 是基于 SSVEP 的辅助型脑机接口，利用 EEG 信号实时选择基本需求。
该 GitHub 项目面向无障碍应用，将稳态视觉诱发电位转化为控制指令。
它是具体的非侵入式 EEG/SSVEP 实现，可用于辅助技术原型开发。
bullets_en: MindAid is an assistive SSVEP-based BCI that uses EEG signals for real-time selection of basic needs.
The GitHub project targets accessibility applications, translating steady-state visual evoked potentials into control commands.
It is a concrete non-invasive EEG/SSVEP implementation useful for assistive technology prototyping.
items.brief: 基于 SSVEP 的辅助型脑机接口，用 EEG 实时选择基本需求。
items.brief_en: Assistive SSVEP BCI uses EEG signals to select basic needs in real time.
items.raw_excerpt: MindAid Assistive SSVEP BCI. Assistive SSVEP-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) for real-time selection of basic needs through EEG signals.

items.title_zh: BrainCo 公共 API 档案（API Evangelist）
items.title_en: BrainCo Public API Surface Profile (API Evangelist)
bullets_zh: API Evangelist 在 GitHub 维护档案，记录 BrainCo 的公共 API 接口面。
BrainCo 被描述为由哈佛创新实验室创立、开发非侵入式脑机接口硬件与开发者 SDK 的公司。
该条目可帮助开发者发现消费/科研 BCI API，但属于第三方资料而非官方文档。
bullets_en: API Evangelist maintains a GitHub profile documenting BrainCo's public API surface.
BrainCo is described as a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded company building non-invasive BCI hardware and developer SDKs.
The entry can help developers discover consumer/research BCI APIs, though it is third-party rather than official docs.
items.brief: 第三方 BrainCo API 档案，帮助发现非侵入式 BCI 开发者接口。
items.brief_en: Third-party BrainCo API profile helps discover non-invasive BCI developer interfaces.
items.raw_excerpt: BrainCo — independent third-party profile of a public API surface, by API Evangelist. BrainCo is a Harvard-innovation-lab-founded neurotechnology company building non-invasive brain-computer interface (BCI) hardware and the developer SDKs that surround it. Its consumer and research line centers on wearable EEG headbands - Focus, Focus1 and FocusCal

items.title_en: AxonOS Community Radar for Open BCI Field
bullets_zh: AxonOS 社区雷达是自动更新的 GitHub 项目，用于绘制开放脑机接口领域地图。
它聚合社区项目与工具，有助于追踪开源脑机接口生态活动。
其相关性取决于在更广泛的脑机接口图谱中筛选非侵入式 EEG/MEG/fNIRS 资源。
bullets_en: AxonOS Community Radar is an auto-updated GitHub project mapping the open brain-computer-interface field.
It aggregates community projects and tools, making it useful for tracking open-source BCI ecosystem activity.
Relevance depends on filtering non-invasive EEG/MEG/fNIRS resources within the broader BCI map.

items.brief_en: Auto-updated radar mapping open brain-computer-interface projects and tools.
items.raw_excerpt: AxonOS Radar — a living, auto-updated map of the open brain-computer-interface field. An AxonOS community project.

items.title_zh: 华中科技大学BCIML EEG解码基准与论文代码库
items.title_en: HUST BCIML EEG Decoding Benchmark and Paper-to-Code Gallery
bullets_zh: 华中科技大学BCIML于2026年9月12日在GitHub发布统一EEG解码基准与可检索论文代码库。
它汇总非侵入式BCI解码方法并提供可复现代码链接。
适合研究者比较EEG模型并查找实现。
bullets_en: HUST BCIML released a unified EEG-decoding benchmark and searchable paper-to-code gallery on GitHub (Sep 12, 2026).
It aggregates non-invasive BCI decoding methods with reproducible code links.
Useful for researchers comparing EEG models and finding implementations.
items.brief: 华科BCIML发布统一EEG解码基准和论文代码检索库，便于复现比较。
items.brief_en: HUST BCIML releases a unified EEG decoding benchmark and paper-to-code gallery for reproducible non-invasive BCI research.
items.raw_excerpt: Unified EEG-decoding benchmark and a searchable paper-to-code gallery for the Brain-Computer Interface and Machine Learning Lab (BCIML), HUST.

items.title_en: ADS1299 Core SDK Open EEG/BCI Ecosystem
bullets_zh: ADS1299-Core-SDK展示面向非侵入式BCI的开放8–64通道EEG硬件与软件生态。
它包含MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA参考包、Verilog RTL、PC/移动/Linux集成以及Python/MATLAB/R分析流程。
适合构建定制EEG采集系统和研究原型。
bullets_en: ADS1299-Core-SDK presents an open 8–64 channel EEG hardware and software ecosystem for non-invasive BCI.
It includes MCU/SoC/DSP/FPGA reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, and Python/MATLAB/R analysis workflows.
Relevant for building custom EEG acquisition systems and research prototypes.
items.brief: ADS1299开放EEG硬件SDK生态，覆盖采集、集成与分析，适合非侵入BCI开发。
items.brief_en: Open ADS1299 EEG/BCI SDK ecosystem covering hardware, integration, and analysis for non-invasive BCI development.
items.raw_excerpt: Building the world’s largest and most comprehensive open ADS1299 EEG/BCI ecosystem — 8–64CH hardware, 200 MCU/SoC/DSP & FPGA target/reference packages, Verilog RTL, PC/mobile/Linux integration, Python/MATLAB/R EEG analysis, BCI workflows, validation, education and research.

bullets_zh: 该GitHub项目提供EEG-Deformer的PyTorch实现，这是一种用于从EEG解码心理状态的卷积Transformer。
它面向非侵入式BCI信号分类与模型复现。
可作为测试基于Transformer的EEG解码器的起点。
bullets_en: This GitHub project provides a PyTorch implementation of EEG-Deformer, a convolutional transformer for decoding mental states from EEG.
It targets non-invasive BCI signal classification and model reproduction.
Useful as a starting point for testing transformer-based EEG decoders.
items.brief: EEG-Deformer的PyTorch实现，用于非侵入式脑电解码与模型复现。
items.brief_en: A PyTorch implementation of EEG-Deformer for non-invasive EEG mental-state decoding and model reproduction.
items.raw_excerpt: Decode mental states from EEG signals using this PyTorch implementation of the EEG-Deformer convolutional transformer for brain-computer interfaces.

items.title_en: NeuroRVQ Rust Inference for EEG/ECG/EMG Tokenization
bullets_zh: 使用 Burn 0.20 构建的纯 Rust NeuroRVQ 推理实现。
无需 Python 依赖即可对 EEG、ECG 和 EMG 信号进行 tokenization。
适合轻量级非侵入式 BCI/生物信号预处理实验。
bullets_en: Pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference implementation built with Burn 0.20.
Tokenizes EEG, ECG and EMG signals without Python dependencies.
Useful for lightweight non-invasive BCI/biosignal preprocessing experiments.
items.brief: 纯 Rust NeuroRVQ 推理项目，可对 EEG/ECG/EMG 信号做 tokenization。

items.raw_excerpt: Build pure-Rust NeuroRVQ inference to tokenize EEG, ECG, and EMG signals with Burn 0.20 and zero Python dependencies
